source: LROC QuickMap (quickmap.lroc.asu.edu), Object Inspector > Inspect, 64x64 px over each target box (~313 m/px), read 2026-11-14
note: Diviner layers added to Inspect sources. Nighttime Soil Temperature (2011) gave 0.4-5.4, not physical surface temperatures (likely a relative/anomaly product), so night minimum uses the published ~95 K (Williams et al. 2017).

layers.H_ppm: Lunar Prospector deconvolved hydrogen map, 0.5 deg bins (ug/g = ppm); negative values are noise around zero
layers.FeO_wt: Lunar Prospector iron abundance, 0.5 deg bins (FeO wt%)
layers.slope_deg: Terrain slope from QuickMap terrain model
